doctrine: The agent harness grows by strengthening existing Overgo owners, not by grafting on a second framework. Recipe owns immutable intent and delegation contracts; agenttool owns manuals, invocation effects, catalog discovery, and dispatch; runrecord owns obligations, trajectories, checkpoints, attempts, and lifecycle evidence; plan owns campaign steering and work claims; operation and workflowruntime own bounded execution; agentloop composes those authorities. No row may add a parallel metadata store, mutable tool registry, scheduler, JSONL authority, checkpoint blob store, interpreter, model-authored execution authority, or transport-specific workflow path. Model cognition may propose actions, but deterministic code derives effects, admission, invalidation, recovery, evaluation, and promotion. Every step must reuse common codecs and lifecycle machinery, fail closed on uncertainty, test the assembled boundary, remove displaced code in the same commit, and justify any net increase in package or policy surface with measured coverage or capability gain.

items.title: Close policy improvement through evidence rather than model authority

steps.title: Represent automation policy versions through existing recipe profile artifacts and runrecord activation evidence. Declared, experimental, verified, active, contained, and rolled-back transitions require exact trajectory evaluations against the incumbent, preserve the rollback target, and move the active alias atomically. No new automation-policy package or mutable policy registry.
steps.rationale: The merged plan's policy lifecycle belongs beside existing agent and experiment authority in runrecord, not behind another service boundary.

steps.title: Extend the existing plan and recipe contracts with a typed steering proposal that binds goal, predicted benefit and cost, uncertainty, falsifiable evaluation, affected authorities, and exact measurement references. Deterministic admission validates every reference and may compile an admitted proposal into future plan rows; proposal text never executes work or grants authority.
steps.rationale: This preserves model-proposed steering while keeping the plan as the sole dispatch surface and avoiding a new steering subsystem.

steps.title: Let the existing loop consume deterministically admitted proposals when the current plan drains, under exact invocation, time, cost, mutation, and experiment budgets; saturation from repeated directions or absent measured gain; unresolved obligations; lease conflicts; and explicit operator stop. The loop may propose and compare policies, but only evidence-gated activation changes the active strategy.
steps.rationale: This is the recursive improvement closure already anticipated on master, now grounded in exact trajectories, obligations, recovery, and policy activation.

items.title: Falsify the agent harness and its gate selection

steps.title: Extend the existing gate false-negative corpus with injected defects covering invocation-effect underclassification, stale obligation evidence, capability-proxy bypass, grant widening, overlapping workspace claims, missing checkpoint coverage, session resume drift, trajectory omission, stale policy activation, and wrong gate exclusion. Each fixture names the check that must run and the invariant that must fail; false positives remain measurable but false negatives fail the suite.
steps.rationale: A deterministic harness is only trustworthy if its own selectors and guards are falsifiable. This expands the existing mutation-test plan rather than creating a second validation runner.

items.title: Prove the capability gain did not create a second framework

steps.title: Run a final structural and behavioral audit over the completed harness: no duplicate stores, registries, schedulers, effect classifiers, checkpoint payload owners, policy lifecycles, or execution switches; no orphaned compatibility paths; all new mutable state bounded and lifecycle-owned; all identities, limits, and distributions derived from authority or measured evidence. Publish before and after surface, coverage, exclusion, recovery, trajectory, and strategy-comparison measurements through the existing census and evaluation records, then delete temporary adapters and superseded code.
steps.verify: rg -q "func TestAgentHarnessConsolidation" internal/repoanalysis -g "*_test.go" && go test ./internal/repoanalysis -run '^TestAgentHarnessConsolidation$' -count=1 && go test ./... -count=1
steps.rationale: Least surface area is a measured acceptance condition, not a coding preference. The campaign ends only when common ownership and whole-repository behavior are proven together.
